steps.title: Plate cells and load Fura2
steps.instruction: Two‑to‑three days before imaging, seed BMP2‑transfected C2C12 myoblasts (or any adherent mammalian line) in an uncoated 35 mm glass‑bottom dish (MatTek, catalog P35G‑0‑14‑C) or uncoated 48‑well glass‑bottom plate (MatTek, catalog P48G‑1.5‑6‑F) and grow to sub‑confluence in a 5 % CO₂, 37 °C incubator. On the day of the experiment, aspirate the culture medium, add 1 ml of 1× Fura2‑staining solution (room temperature), incubate in the dark at room temperature for 30 min, aspirate, wash twice with physiological solution, then add imaging solution containing luciferase (990 µl per 35 mm dish or 297 µl per 48‑well) and let the cells acclimatize for 10 min at room temperature under low‑light conditions.

substeps.instruction: Seed cells in appropriate glass‑bottom vessel and grow to sub‑confluence.
Aspirate medium and add 1 ml 1× Fura2‑staining solution.
Incubate 30 min at room temperature in the dark.
Aspirate staining solution and wash twice with physiological solution.
Add imaging solution with luciferase (990 µl/35 mm dish or 297 µl/48‑well).
Acclimatize 10 min at room temperature in light‑limiting conditions.

steps.title: Prepare physiological solution (PS)
steps.instruction: Make 1 L of physiological solution (pH 7.4) containing 130 mM NaCl, 5 mM KCl, 1 mM MgCl₂·6H₂O, 1 mM CaCl₂·2H₂O, 10 mM D‑(+)-glucose, and 20 mM HEPES. Sterilize by 0.2 µm vacuum filtration and store at 4 °C.

steps.title: Prepare Fura2 staining solution
steps.instruction: Dilute the Fura2‑AM stock (1 µg/µl in DMSO, stored at –20 °C, protected from light) 1:1,000 into physiological solution to obtain a 1× Fura2‑staining solution. Prepare fresh and protect from light.

steps.title: Prepare luciferin imaging solutions
steps.instruction: For the solution with luciferase, combine 2 µl of 30 mM D‑luciferin stock (1:5,000 dilution), 40 µl of 1 mg/ml firefly luciferase stock (1:250 dilution), and 10 ml physiological solution; prepare fresh and protect from light. For the solution without luciferase, combine 2 µl of the same D‑luciferin stock with 10 ml physiological solution; prepare fresh and protect from light.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 µl 30 mM D‑luciferin stock to 10 ml physiological solution.
For the luciferase‑containing version, also add 40 µl 1 mg/ml firefly luciferase stock.
Mix gently, keep protected from light, and use immediately.

steps.title: Prepare ATP solutions and convert ADP
steps.instruction: Make ATP solutions ranging from 10 µM to 100 mM in the luciferin imaging solution without luciferase (1×). For calibration, prepare a 10 mM ATP stock and perform serial 1:10 dilutions to obtain lower concentrations (e.g., 1 mM, 0.1 mM, etc.). To eliminate contaminating ADP, add 5 µl of 20 U/ml pyruvate kinase and 5 µl of 100 µM phosphoenolpyruvate (PEP) to each ATP stock, incubate 30 min at 37 °C, then heat‑inactivate 5 min at 95 °C.

substeps.instruction: Dissolve ATP to 10 mM in luciferin imaging solution without luciferase.
Serially dilute 1:10 to obtain the desired concentration range (0.1 µM–1 mM).
Add 5 µl 20 U/ml pyruvate kinase and 5 µl 100 µM PEP to each stock.
Incubate 30 min at 37 °C, then heat‑inactivate 5 min at 95 °C.

steps.title: Prepare stock solutions
steps.instruction: Prepare and store the following stocks: (1) Fura2‑AM 1 µg/µl in DMSO (1,000×), stored at –20 °C protected from light; (2) D‑luciferin 30 mM in physiological solution (5,000×), stored at –80 °C protected from light; (3) firefly luciferase 1 mg/ml in physiological solution (500×), stored at –80 °C protected from light.

steps.title: Set up microscope and UV lamp
steps.instruction: Turn on the UV lamp 10–20 min before imaging to allow warm‑up. Place a drop of Carl Zeiss Immersol Immersion Oil (Fisher Scientific, catalog 12‑070‑397) on the 40× objective, position the glass‑bottom dish or plate on the lens, bring cells into focus, and verify that both cell‑filled and cell‑free regions are visible in the field of view. Open the imaging software (e.g., Volocity) and set: sampling rate = 2 time points / s; exposure time = 50–200 ms (use the minimal exposure that yields low‑noise images); excitation/emission = 380 nm/510 nm. If an automated shutter (e.g., Lambda DG‑4) is available, close it between exposures to reduce photobleaching.

substeps.instruction: Warm up UV lamp for 10–20 min.
Apply immersion oil to 40× objective.
Mount dish/plate and focus on cells.
Configure imaging software with the parameters above.

steps.title: Acquire baseline and stimulus recordings
steps.instruction: Record 10–15 s of baseline fluorescence, then apply the chosen stimulus (mechanical via glass micropipette or biochemical added at 1 % volume of a 100× stock to reach the desired final concentration) and continue recording for an additional 100–120 s. Use the same acquisition settings for all trials.

substeps.instruction: Record baseline (10–15 s).
Add stimulus (mechanical or 1 % volume of 100× solution).
Record post‑stimulus response (100–120 s).

steps.title: Perform control recordings
steps.instruction: Run the following controls: (a) Cell‑free wells with luciferase‑free imaging solution – record vehicle alone versus vehicle + drug to assess drug effects on D‑luciferin signal; (b) Cell‑free wells with luciferase‑supplemented imaging solution – record ATP alone versus ATP + drug to assess drug effects on luciferase activity; (c) Wells with Fura2‑loaded cells in luciferase‑supplemented imaging solution – add vehicle (physiological solution) to control for mechanical agitation caused by solution addition.

substeps.instruction: Control 1: Cell‑free, no luciferase – vehicle vs vehicle + drug.
Control 2: Cell‑free, with luciferase – ATP vs ATP + drug.
Control 3: Fura2‑loaded cells, with luciferase – add vehicle only.

steps.title: Generate ATP calibration curve
steps.instruction: In triplicate wells, add 1 % volume of 100× ATP solution to achieve the target ATP concentration (e.g., add 3 µl of 100 µM ATP to 297 µl imaging solution in a 48‑well plate to obtain 1 µM ATP). Perform this both in the presence and absence of luciferase (positive and negative controls). Test concentrations from 0.1 µM to 1 000 µM. Apply the same stimulation protocol as used for experimental recordings. Calibration may be performed with or without Fura2‑loaded cells; inclusion of cells is recommended to mimic experimental conditions.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 % volume of 100× ATP solution to each well.
Run parallel wells with and without luciferase.
Record fluorescence using the same imaging parameters.
Repeat for each ATP concentration (0.1–1 000 µM) in triplicate.

steps.title: Prepare phosphate‑buffered saline (PBS)
steps.instruction: Dissolve 140 mM NaCl, 3 mM KCl, 10 mM Na₂HPO₄, and 2 mM KH₂PO₄ in water, adjust pH to 7.4, sterilize by autoclaving, and store at room temperature.
